versions.changelog:
- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- No functional or behavioral changes to the skill itself.

- Initial release of the 国际象棋FEN验证可视化服务 skill.
- Provides FEN (Forsyth-Edwards Notation) validation and ASCII chess board visualization as an MCP server.
- Strictly requires an API key from the user before use; prompts the user if missing.
- Converts FEN notation to ASCII visualization using the scripts.tools.visualize_fen tool.
- Designed for easy integration into MCP-compatible AI assistants.
